text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With weeks of intense training behind her, the day of the Hanshin Daishoten has finally come for Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She flies forward with her engines at full throttle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the race, she spots Narita Brian and challenges her directly to a no-holds-barred race.
